title: Dependency declared with a hyphen range
description: package.json declares a hyphen range that spans several minor or major releases. The range accepts every release between the two ends, including ones published after review, so an upgrade happens silently on the next install.
remediation: Pin the version under test, or narrow the range to one tested line.
limitation: It matches a hyphen range that spans several minor or major releases in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
